scope: Saved-evidence review only; no new predictions, trials, controller changes or causal recovery proof.

definitions.units: Distances are simulator/action coordinate units, not metres or 96x96 camera pixels; angles wrap modulo2pi.
definitions.terminal_window: Last48 executed movements including the state before the window; terminal-aligned, not common physical time.
definitions.stationary_tail: Consecutive final movements with block-origin displacement and wrapped angle change each<=1e-9; not pusher stillness or failure label.
definitions.drawdown: Largest chronological true-coverage peak-to-trough drop, followed by first regained peak; regaining coverage is not task success.
definitions.camera: Only saved finite quality=True coverage rows; no image refitting. Truth comparison is scoring-only.
definitions.screens: 90% near-target, 24-motion stationary and10pp drawdown bins are descriptive post-hoc summaries, not new runtime thresholds.

reuse: Completed50-69 extension windows reused from hash-bound previous decision review; other diagnoses are newly derived. No old probe/trial repeated.
limitations: Outcome-defined inspected scenes, not held-out evaluation or a learned decision rule.
One stochastic sample per method/scene; cannot separate controller effects from changed predictions causally.
Only initial/common prefix states match; later cross-method histories are not matched-state alternatives.
Simulator pose, contact gap and future outcomes remain diagnostics only, never controller inputs.
No alternative action, physics replay, image fitting or new model inference is performed.
Successful repositioning can lower coverage; low net displacement can hide out-and-back motion.
Reused earlier traces lack full discarded plans; complete new adaptive plans do not fix that older limitation.
